governing_intent: Implement a GitHub Projects Anti-Corruption Layer and authenticated direct-webhook ingress that maintain a noncanonical READY view while preserving the fixed upstream-to-execution authority boundary.
summary: PY-05 is bounded, vertically coherent, and executable without inventing Founder or architecture decisions. Its requirement extents are honest: primary for SF-REQ-005, contributing only event freshness for SF-REQ-001 and ingress custody for SF-REQ-008.
implementation_unknowns: Concrete GitHub API/event-schema and pagination handling compatible with the recorded fixtures.
Exact typed port, profile-schema, receipt, rejection, and unavailable outcome representations constrained by PY-04 and PY-03.
Adapter-local conditional-write or serialized projection-fencing mechanism.
Recorded fixture coverage for GitHub payload variants and local webhook-server test harness.
verification_assessment: Real executable proof is specified: recorded-payload contract tests, a locally served endpoint with real raw-body HMAC verification, durable duplicate/stale-event behavior through PY-03, projection-fencing and outage tests, sentinel secret-leak testing, architecture fitness checks, and the Node suite. Fixture/API research is normal implementation work, not a verification gap.
material_risks: GitHub API and webhook capabilities must be verified against supported schemas; unsupported, ambiguous, missing-membership, incomplete-page, or unsafe-ordering cases must remain typed fail-closed outcomes.
The implementation must preserve the PY-03 receipt-before-acknowledgment and expected-version semantics rather than introducing an adapter-local durability path.
Projection echoes and externally edited execution display fields must remain drift observations and never become lifecycle commands.
next_action: When PY-03 and PY-04 are accepted, release PY-05 for implementation on its declared clean-main baseline; resolve the listed implementation details through adapter research and recorded-fixture tests.
rationale: Binding authority fixes ownership, release, transport, authentication, durability, no-polling, configuration, secret handling, and Python/Node coexistence. The remaining details are explicitly gate-classified category-B implementation work. The adapter, ingress, minimal profile/secret adapter, and composition wiring form one integration vertical around the same profile-scoped Work Management boundary, so splitting would increase seam risk without resolving an independent decision.
